environment.backend: Worktree-local Firebase emulators and authenticated HTTP APIs. The reply endpoint used the production handler and Firestore runner with a controlled model provider. Only synthetic accounts and data were used.

renderer.initialFrame: Official Zundamon model rendered with alpha
renderer.interaction: Wave and expression produced different pixels

checks.voiceAndFallback: Blocked the character asset. The same local chat entry opened. An emulated microphone recorded audio, enabled preview, and placed a removable voice attachment in the shared draft.

exports.web: Static Web pages and local companion payload
exports.android: Hermes plus Expo DOM HTML/JS and matching companion payload

limitations: No paid model or production deployment was used.
Android and iPhone device rendering, real microphones and software keyboards were not exercised.
The end-to-end selection example used a task. Care records and family documents were checked through their source, schema and type bindings.
developmentFindings: The initial Core load exposed its interface before Wasm was ready. Drawing now waits for the Core version API.
The SDK motion required empty effect ID vectors. A second rendered frame verified the corrected gesture.
The development bundler retained an earlier send signature across the monorepo boundary. The clean Web export sent the correct page reference and completed the continuation scenario.

followUp.scenario: A shared task is open at 390 x 844. Tap the character, choose a different authorized private child without leaving the current URL, and send a question.
followUp.environment: Edge on local Expo Web, actual Firebase Auth and Firestore emulators, AI disabled.
followUp.scope: One focused browser scenario. The initial package checks above remain the evidence for other flows.
